text.p: HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - The IFC, The Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency and the World Bank will present their support programmes for small and medium-sized enterprise in Slovakia on February 10 and 11.

- Steel producer VSZ Kosice now appears to have fulfiled the requirement of the National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) to reduce its stake in the third largest commercial bank, IRB, under the permitted 15 percent.
- The private sector accounted for 252 billion crowns, or 94.6 percent, of the 266.5 billion crowns worth retail sales in the January-November period last year.

SME - The state Council for Radio and Television Broadcasting will, by the end of the year, conclude a tender for a new owner of one of the two TV channels operated by the official Slovak Television. The winner of the tender will have to be approved by the parliament.

PRAVDA - The opposition parties have proposed to Prime Minister Vladimir Meciar to hold talks in February on intergration into NATO and the European Union and on socio-economic conditions in Slovakia.
- Agriculture Minister Peter Baco said prices of milk products should increase by some 6-7 percent this year.
- Baco said prices of other food items should increase by a maximum of the inflation rate.
